blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Northwest Maple Ridge has no official City boundary — it is a board sub-area name, and the City's neighbourhood list does not include it.

Its house streets run west of the Town Centre toward the Pitt Meadows border, around 206 Street, 123 Avenue and Abernethy Way, with Fairview Elementary at 12209 206 Street and Laity View Elementary at 21023 123 Avenue as the street anchors.
Maple Meadows Station at 20010 Dunn Avenue sits at this area's southwest side, on the Pitt Meadows side of the municipal edge of the wider west side.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The dividing rule here is servicing and land designation, read lot by lot: northern lots can fall in the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR), where the Agricultural Land Commission limits a parcel to one principal residence plus at most one additional smaller residence.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Davie Jones Elementary at 12030 Blakely Road is in Pitt Meadows, not Maple Ridge, even though it is one of the schools buyers ask about for streets near the municipal border — do not assume a Maple Ridge address falls in its catchment.

Bear rules bite hardest on the northern, treed lots: garbage carts go out no earlier than 5:00 a.m. and come in by 7:00 p.m. on collection day under the City's Wildlife and Vector Control Bylaw guidance.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: The Northwest-specific cost check is farm classification and ALR status on northern lots, which change what can be built; neither is stated on a tax notice, so verify both before removing subjects.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge Houses: getting around

items.t: Maple Meadows Station is this area's transport anchor, at 20010 Dunn Avenue, with West Coast Express trains running weekdays toward Waterfront and Mission City.
Haney Place Exchange, with the R3 RapidBus and routes including 701 and 743, is the bus hub east of this area in the Town Centre.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: The first check on a northern lot is floodplain: Floodplain Management Bylaw No. 8121-2026 covers the Alouette River system as well as the Fraser River, and designates land within its Schedule A hazard areas and land less than 1.5 metres above a watercourse's natural boundary.
ALR status is the second check, and it is per parcel on the Agricultural Land Commission's mapping — a lot can look like a normal house lot and still carry ALR housing limits.

Treed lots at the urban edge can fall in the City's Wildfire Development Permit Area, where a development permit, or a restrictive covenant on design and landscaping for a single detached home, can be required.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Northwest Maple Ridge
North of Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road, from about 224 Street to the Pitt Meadows line, Northwest Maple Ridge covers the west side. Urban streets give way to rural lots as you head north.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Northwest?

faq.q: Is Northwest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?

faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 22 houses sold in Northwest; Maple Ridge as a whole recorded 247.
